items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: So you worked with the Ellington band and who all else was in that -- Marie Bryant and Dorothy Dandridge and Pot Pan and Skillet.

ctx.x: So you worked with the Ellington band and who all else was in that --
Marie Bryant and Dorothy Dandridge and Pot Pan and Skillet. Ivy Anderson started out there, and let me see who else.
